description: Defines a SwiftUI view `MenuHostedItem` that hosts arbitrary SwiftUI content within an AppKit `NSMenuItem`. It enables embedding SwiftUI views into native macOS menu items by wrapping them in an `NSViewRepresentable` that manages sizing and view updates.

classes.name: MenuHostedItem
classes.description: A SwiftUI `NSViewRepresentable` that embeds a SwiftUI view (`AnyView`) inside an AppKit `NSHostingView`, facilitating its use within native macOS menu items.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and returns an `NSHostingView` initialized with the provided `rootView`, and applies sizing.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the existing `NSHostingView` with the current `rootView` and re-applies sizing.

methods.name: applySizing
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the hosting view based on the specified width and its fitting size.
